notes: Official Barco spec sheet (PDF, last updated 19 Jun 2026) confirms: Video output 4K UHD (3840x2160)@30Hz via HDMI 1.4b or USB-C DisplayPort 1.2 (Gen2 only); Connections: 1x Ethernet LAN 1Gbit, 1x USB-C 2.0 + 1x USB-A 2.0 (front, Gen1) — Gen2 only: 1x USB-C 3.0 + 1x USB-A 3.0 (front); Power supply: standard 110/220V AC plug or USB-C (Gen2 only); Power consumption 5-10W operational, 24W max; Kensington lock present (not modeled as a signal/power port). This device is a small desktop conferencing puck (34x135x135mm, 900g) — no rackUnits (desktop, omitted). The spec sheet does not explicitly name the DC input connector type; barrel-connector inference is corroborated by Barco's spare-parts listing of a 12VDC/2A external power adapter (B563182K) shared across the C-5/C-10/CX-20/CX-30 family, but the primary source does not show a rear-panel diagram confirming barrel vs other DC connector shape, hence medium confidence. HDMI is output-only from the base unit (there is no HDMI input on this model — video comes wirelessly/via USB-C from a laptop, not via HDMI in). Ports reflect the current Gen2 hardware (shipping variant as of search date); Gen1 units instead have USB-C 2.0 + USB-A 2.0 and no USB-C DisplayPort/power option. Barco's own product/support pages (barco.com/en/product/clickshare-cx-20 and the installation manual) returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch and could not be used directly to cross-check the rear-panel silkscreen labels.

ports.name: HDMI Out
ports.note: Video output to room display, 4K UHD @30Hz; HDMI 1.4b per spec sheet

ports.name: USB-C
ports.note: Gen2: USB-C 3.0 (front); also supports DisplayPort 1.2 alt-mode video output and can accept USB-C power input (Gen2 only)

ports.name: USB-A
ports.note: Gen2: USB-A 3.0 (front); Gen1 units have USB-A/USB-C 2.0 instead

ports.name: DC In
ports.note: External power adapter (12VDC per Barco spare-parts listing B563182K); spec sheet lists supply as "Standard 110/220V AC plug or USB-C (only Gen2)" — the AC plug feeds an external brick that outputs DC via barrel connector into the base unit; USB-C port can alternatively power the unit on Gen2.
